svg.title: Stage folders vs stage packages
svg.desc: Option 1 keeps one scheduler package with a folder per pipeline stage. Option 2 makes each stage a package; motion planning already is one (motion_planner), and a scheduler_core package is needed first.

g.text: Rule, checked by a CI include grep: a stage folder never includes another stage folder, scheduler.hpp or ros/. Inside task_planning, job_expansion may call tray_assignment's public functions.

g.text: Both options follow the five pipeline stages. Option 1 draws the boundaries as folders inside scheduler; Option 2 makes them packages, which needs a scheduler_core package first. Recommended: Option 1 now, promote action_graph first,
